messages.subject: Error in recordTable regarding pictures
parts:
Dear Juergen,
Previously I was using the below code and everything was corrected. 

pic_spp_table <- recordTable(inDir= "D:/Digikam/Filmy", IDfrom = "metadata", minDeltaTime = 0, deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastRecord", metadataSpeciesTag = "GATUNEK", timeZone = "Europe/Warsaw", writecsv = TRUE, outDir = "D:/Digikam/Filmy")

However, below error occured and I have no information from several folders with pictures:

Error in the command 'matrix(unlist(lapply(tmp1, FUN = function(X) {':
  'data' must be a vector, it was 'NULL

Could you please help me with this situation?

Thank you very much

With best regards,
Magda Sitarz

Dear Magda,

which version are you using now, and what exactly was "previously"?

What I can tell you already is that this is an unexpected error and thus some bug. But the relevant code hasn't changed in years. Did the data change in any way?

I suppose it has to do with Exiftool not returning anything at a particular station. Is the folder structure in D:/Digikam/Filmy" correct and contains jpg images in all stations?

Best regards,

Jürgen
